The '''Imperial waystation''' was a base of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[contested crossroads]] of [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].

During the [[Battle of Ilum]] the personnel stationed there included [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Baramak]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barstead]].<ref name="SAB" /><ref name="OWN" />
